description:
A complete loan and savings calculator. Every calculation runs on your device. Only live currency rates need the internet.

LOANS
Calculate EMI, or solve for the amount, rate or tenure you can actually afford. See the full amortisation schedule month by month, with a chart of how each year splits between principal and interest. Model part payments, advance EMIs, a moratorium, or a change in rate, and see what each one saves. Compare two offers side by side including processing fees. Save your loans and track payments against them. Set EMI reminders and get a local notification in the days before an instalment is due, on the day, and once after if it stays unpaid.

SAVINGS AND INVESTMENTS
Fixed and recurring deposits, PPF, SIP, SWP, STP, lumpsum, and SIP adjusted for inflation. Simple and compound interest, and what inflation does to a sum over time.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
GST, currency conversion, percentages, discounts, tip and bill splitting, fuel cost for a trip, the difference between two dates, and age.

BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
No account. No ads. No tracking. Every figure is computed on your device and stored only on your device. Every amount is shown in rupees with Indian digit grouping, and the currency converter still covers other currencies. Export any schedule as a PDF. Full dark mode.
promotionalText: Work out any loan EMI, see exactly how much of each payment is interest, and find out what a part payment really saves you. No account, no ads, no tracking.
whatsNew:
EMI reminders are here.

- Get a local notification in the days before an instalment is due, on the day it is due, and once after if it stays unpaid. Pick the time of day in Settings.
- Every amount is now shown in rupees with Indian digit grouping. The currency converter still converts other currencies.
